page0.text:
If I recall correctly...
I think she asked me whether I would keep trying until the end, no matter what.

page1.text:
"...Rider. I'll fight until the very end. I want to save Sakura, just like you want to protect her. I don't know how it'll turn out, but I can't run from this.
...I'll fight to bring Sakura back. If you're going to stop me, then I'll do everything I can to eliminate you."
"..."

page2.text:
She doesn't answer.
After an oppressive silence, Rider speaks.

page3.text:
"I understand your conviction. But that cannot save Sakura."
She gives me a curt reply, and vanishes.

page4.text:
"Rider...?"
"Fight your war. I will do whatever I can to save Sakura."
